title: Hearing on the City's snow removal and winter storm response
summary: The Council's Sanitation Committee held an oversight hearing on the Department of Sanitation's response to the January 25-26 and February 22-23, 2026 winter storms, which brought up to 23.4 inches of snow and prompted a state of emergency. The hearing also examined Intro 1042, which would require Sanitation to publish a public website with real-time and historical GPS data on snow plowing operations, updated every 15 minutes during storms. The committee heard testimony from the Department of Sanitation and the public on preparedness for the 2026-2027 winter season.
